protocol.description:
ext-background-effect-v1 lets a client ask for blur behind a surface but leaves how strong it is to the compositor. This extension lets the client hint a strength for that blur, per surface.
It only modulates a blur requested through ext-background-effect-v1: with no blur region set, the strength has no effect. A compositor that does not offer this global simply applies its own default strength.
Warning! The protocol described in this file is experimental and backward incompatible changes may be made. Backward compatible changes may be added together with the corresponding interface version bump. Backward incompatible changes are done by bumping the version number in the protocol and interface names and resetting the interface version.

description.summary: get the blur strength object of a surface

request.description: Create a strength object for the surface. Raises already_exists if the surface already has one.

interface.name: zbackground_effect_strength_v1
interface.description: If the surface is destroyed, this object becomes inert.

request.description: The compositor default applies again from the next commit.
